main_text.p: quandam nebula speciem repraesentant, ut ipse Illuftriff. Vir loquitnr: Sic etiam quando Sol oriens terram a pluvia vel rore nocturno humectatam illuminat, tunc ejus radii nebulam levant quidem, at non una fecum fecundum pernicitatem motus Lucis abducunt, sed aliis aliisque identidem halitibus excitatis, senfim altius attollunt; quae pedetentim usque ad collium vertices afcendit, (non quod aethe-rea fubstantia eidem maneat agglutinata, sed quod, illa fe fubducente atque liberius remeante furfum, ipsofque halitus deferente, a fubsequentibus interim halitibus, nec non subsequente materia aetherea, propellatur:) atque haec nebula rarefit, & attenuatur, prout Sol majorem furfum eam trahendi vim & efficaciam obtinet, (prout, inquam, aetherea substantiae fluxus vel nisus contingit copiosior aut validior, adeo que prout Lucis vigor actu exiftit major; velut Luce remittente, seu nocturno tempore atque in locis ad quae folis radii.

page.notes: The bullet before "aetherea" is a printer's mark, not text. Some words in the last lines are faint or cut at the foot; "sequentibus" and "aetherea" are the likely readings. Transcription of the running head taken from the page header. Catchword and signature not visible.
